Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor docs for onboarding - Nova Systems

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the COI and the limits look fine, however the certificate does not include Redwood Inference as Additional Insured nor a waiver of subrogation endorsement. For activation of the vendor record and to issue a PO we require one of the following:

- A policy endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" as Additional Insured on the General Liability policy; and
- A waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference on the General Liability policy.

You can either have your broker issue an endorsement (preferred) or upload a revised COI that explicitly references the endorsement number. Once we receive the endorsed COI we will move the vendor to active status and create PO.

I’m attaching the vendor onboarding instructions with steps for uploading documents to the vendor portal and sample endorsement language to share with your broker. If you expect a delay getting an endorsement, let me know and we can discuss conditional PO options but that requires signoff from contracting.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-instructions.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

If you need Redwood explicitly named, we can request a policy amendment but that may take a couple of business days.
